name: Manipulate Currents
description: While underwater, the creature can change the flow of water within 60 feet of it. It can choose one of the following effects, which lasts until the start of its next turn. • A 20-foot cube of rushing water forms on a point the creature can see in the water. The cube’s space is difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn swimming in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed out of the cube directly away from the creature. • The current shoots in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line from the creature in a direction it chooses. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the creature in a direction following the line. • The creature takes the Dash action
